title: Hold a licence to grow or process industrial hemp
what: Cultivate, harvest or process industrial hemp only under and in accordance with a licence.

sources.title: Industrial Hemp Act 2004 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not — (a) cultivate industrial hemp; (b) harvest industrial hemp; or (c) process industrial hemp, except under and in accordance with a licence
